items.description: While the electrocution of a young woman leads Murdoch to a war between rival electricity suppliers, and no less than Nikola Tesla (Dmitry Chepovetsky), Crabtree (Jonny Harris) finds himself attracted to a suspect.
items.title: 1. Power

items.description: When two respected officers of the court are murdered, Brackenreid (Thomas Craig) fears he’s next on the hit list; meanwhile, Murdoch interviews for the Inspector’s position at a new station.
items.title: 2. The Glass Ceiling

items.description: We're off to the (silent) races with Murdoch Mysteries, to celebrate the Season 12 premiere!
items.title: Trailer

items.description: After being designed by architect Frank Lloyd Wright, Murdoch and Ogden’s house is rocked by an explosion that claims a man’s life. Guest starring Downton Abbey’s Sophie McShera.
items.title: 1. Murdoch Mystery Mansion

items.description: Ogden enlists Murdoch to investigate possible sabotage in the operating room after a patient dies during a routine medical procedure.
items.title: 2. Operation: Murder

items.callToActionTitle: S12 | 3. My Big Fat Mimico Wedding
items.description: When Murdoch, Ogden, Crabtree and Brackenreid attend Higgins’ and Ruth Newsome’s wedding, a guest repeatedly tries to kill the groom.
items.title: 3. My Big Fat Mimico Wedding

items.description: After anti-immigrant laws lead to the arrests of Greek men, Brackenreid regrets releasing his carpenter when he’s suspected of murder.
items.title: 4. Murdoch Without Borders

items.callToActionTitle: S12 | 5. The Spy Who Loved Murdoch
items.description: When Murdoch impersonates a dead diplomat to save a treaty, political, and sexual intrigue complicate matters.
items.title: 5. The Spy Who Loved Murdoch

items.description: Murdoch investigates an astronomical phenomenon with a strange impact on his colleagues' behaviour and dire implications for Toronto.
items.title: 6. Sir. Sir? Sir!!!

items.description: When Watts kills a man in self-defense, and Murdoch uncovers the victim's criminal past, questions surround Watts' story.
items.title: 7. Brother's Keeper

items.description: When a wealthy, high society couple is found drowned in their pool in an apparent double suicide, Murdoch suspects murder.
items.title: 8. Drowning in Money

items.description: When Brackenreid leaves Toronto to help an old friend find a missing woman, he learns he's a lot closer to the case than he thought.
items.title: 9. Secrets and Lies

items.callToActionTitle: S12 | 10. Pirates of the Great Lakes
items.description: As Murdoch helps an Italian detective recover a shipload of stolen antiquities, Brackenreid considers shipping out.
items.title: 10. Pirates of the Great Lakes

items.description: Crabtree and John are transporting a convicted axe murderer to prison when she escapes to exact revenge on those who testified against her.
items.title: 11. Annabella Cinderella

items.description: Murdoch’s distressing childhood memories are evoked while investigating the death of an orphan under the care of the same Jesuit priest who taught him.
items.title: 12. Six of the Best

items.callToActionTitle: S12 | 13. Murdoch and the Undetectable Man
items.description: Murdoch enlists inventor Nikola Tesla to help with the murder investigation of a man experimenting with invisibility.
items.title: 13. Murdoch and the Undetectable Man

items.description: When a man dies in a deliberately set fire, Murdoch’s investigation reveals some shocking personal history.
items.title: 14. Sins of the Father

items.description: When a man is electrocuted during a typing contest with Crabtree and Louise Cherry, Murdoch suspects the reporter was the intended target.
items.title: 15. One Minute to Murder

items.description: After the release of Murdoch and Ogden’s book, a series of copycat murders begin to take place.
items.title: 16. The Manual for Murder

items.description: As Murdoch seeks a promotion, a constable is shot in a botched raid on an opium den led by Watts.
items.title: 17. Darkness Before Dawn (Pt. 1)

items.description: Murdoch suspects John is being framed for murder by Inspector McWorthy, and Brackenreid goes after the corrupt copper.
items.title: 18. Darkness Before Dawn (Pt. 2)
